name: elastio
description: Elastio blue-stack house rules, distilled from incidents and team conventions.

rules.rule:
- Every query/read/write is bound to the tenant (tenant_name / tenant id) and the caller's RBAC scope. A cross-tenant read or an unscoped id lookup is a blocker.
- Every user value reaches SQL as a bind parameter; sort/group/column names come from fixed maps.
- Rollout or enforcement switches are flagtgl flags, never env vars or helm values.
- Never adds a staging/production promotion or touches prod data.
- Secrets never appear in code, logs, fixtures or PR text.

- Migrations must be safe at production size: no data backfills, no full-table rewrites, no long locks in a sqlx/helm-hook migration (the 2026-09-28 OVA migration stalled prod). Backfills go in a separate job.
- New FKs/columns must not break the deploy order (migration before the API that reads it). Indexes on large tables: CONCURRENTLY where the runner allows.
- Any new column read by a filter/OR/JOIN on a hot path needs an index or a stated reason.

- sqlx-data.json / offline query data updated when queries change.
- Rust: no unwrap/expect on request or DB data paths; errors map to the right HTTP status (400 vs 404 vs 409 vs 500).

- API schemas: enums and formats validated (unknown value -> 400, not empty 200); responses set additionalProperties:false where siblings do; list endpoints are paginated or capped and report truncation.
- uiv3: UI copy must state what the API actually does (no claims about data the endpoint does not pin/sort/filter). New surfaces reuse Findings/Incidents chrome and chip-row filters. Drawers go through the single-owner URL-param registry.
- uiv3: a new doc/ file needs front matter and a regenerated INDEX.md.

- Context and tenant are threaded through; no goroutine without cancellation; DB errors are not swallowed.
- Optimistic concurrency (If-Match / FOR UPDATE) preserved on mutation paths.

- Chart changes must not depend on a manual kubectl override; ConfigMaps that helm never re-renders are called out.
- No container runs as root on shared runners.
